offering_description.value: Stagwell provides advertising, media buying, digital experience design, research and public relations to brands and institutions. Its agencies deliver the work, and its software helps marketing teams research audiences, plan campaigns and measure results.

primary_products.value: Audience research software; campaign planning and measurement software; public relations software; augmented reality fan engagement platforms

primary_services.value: Advertising strategy and creative production; media planning and buying; digital product and experience design; market research and analytics; public relations and public affairs

customer_segment.value: B2B: Consumer brands, retailers, technology companies, financial institutions and nonprofits; B2G: Public agencies commissioning communications and outreach campaigns

end_markets.value: Consumer goods and retail; technology; financial services; healthcare; travel and hospitality

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Campaign development, creative production and digital experience projects; service fees: Ongoing agency retainers for marketing, research and communications; commissions or management fees: Planning and placing paid media for advertisers; subscription: Access to marketing, research and communications software
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; commissions or management fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Turns client briefs and audience research into campaigns, media placements and digital experiences for brands and institutions; software / platform: Turns survey, media and campaign data into planning and measurement tools for marketing teams

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Advertising, media, digital experience, market research, communications and marketing software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Agency account teams and enterprise software sales teams; online: Web-based marketing and research platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Advertising subject to FTC rules and personal data use subject to privacy laws such as GDPR and CCPA

notes: The exact current mix of standalone software products is uncertain.
